note: Every one of them is invented. 'where' lists when each tends to be where; p is the chance on a given day. Cards are the People entries written the first time Hegel meets them.

ramesh.name: Ramesh
ramesh.role: caretaker of the bungalow for the Central Public Works Department

malhotra.name: Mr. R. K. Malhotra
malhotra.short: Mr. R. K. Malhotra, retired IAS
malhotra.role: retired from the Indian Administrative Service

nidhi.name: Nidhi Rao
nidhi.short: Nidhi Rao, doctoral student in philosophy

kapoor.name: Mrs. Kapoor
kapoor.card: Taught history for thirty-one years at a girls' school in Lodhi Colony. Walks the gardens in the late afternoon and reads every plaque twice, once for the facts and once for the mistakes.

saxena.name: Mr. Saxena
saxena.card: Keeper of the file. Tea in a steel tumbler, three telephones on the desk, and a patience that has outlasted several ministers.

sunil.name: Sunil
sunil.card: Boils tea on a kerosene stove, mornings by the Lodhi Road gate, afternoons in the lane behind Khan Market. Knows the price of everything and the business of everyone.

hegde.name: Shri G. Hegde
hegde.card: The man the bungalow was meant for. Courteous, tired, and carrying the patience of a career spent in files.
